description.text: The Collect 151 special missions of China's Pokémon Card Member WeChat mini-program, which ran from 17 January to 31 December 2025, gave a Collect 151 binder to members who entered two gym events through the mini-program, and a special illustration Mew ex by monthly draw. From March 2025, on the 15th of each month, 151 members who had played at least 15 events at three or more different gyms or venues in the previous 151 days were drawn to get one, 1,510 cards in all, and a member could be drawn only once.
